scope: Fix a real bug where executeAction's catch block returns a raw Error object that silently serializes to {} in every JSON API response, hiding real failure reasons from every browser-agent caller.

steps.title: Fix swallowed error in executeAction -- raw Error object serializes to {} over JSON
steps.task: executeAction's catch block returns the raw Error object, which has no enumerable own properties and serializes to {} in every JSON response, hiding the real failure reason from every caller. Return error.message instead, using PATCH MODE.
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only
